title: A Message for Zeynep
text:
Ali sends a text message to his friend Zeynep every morning. The message is short, for example: 'Good morning! Are you coming to school today?' Zeynep usually replies after five minutes. Sometimes she sends a photo too.

Yesterday Ali sent a message to ask about the homework. Zeynep did not answer for two hours because her phone was in her bag. Ali was worried, so he called her. She said sorry and sent the homework by message.

questions.text: Who does Ali send a text message to every morning?
Why did Zeynep not answer for two hours?
options: Her phone was in her bag
She did not like the homework

questions.text: What can you infer about Ali from the text?
options: He lives far away from Zeynep

questions.text: What does the passage suggest about text messages?
options: They are a quick way to share information

vocabulary.definition: a short written communication sent from one phone to another
feeling afraid that something bad might happen
a picture taken with a camera or a phone
work that students do at home after school

paragraph_translations: Ali her sabah arkadaşı Zeynep'e kısa bir mesaj gönderir. Mesaj kısadır, örneğin: 'Günaydın! Bugün okula geliyor musun?' Zeynep genellikle beş dakika sonra cevap verir. Bazen bir fotoğraf da gönderir.

Dün Ali ödev hakkında sormak için bir mesaj gönderdi. Zeynep'in telefonu çantasındaydı, bu yüzden iki saat cevap vermedi. Ali endişelendi, bu yüzden onu aradı. Zeynep özür diledi ve ödevi mesajla gönderdi.
